study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modeling of brain morphometry in self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Multivariable fractional polynomial regression implemented with the mfp package in R, following the CentileBrain framework. This algorithm determines the functional form of the predictor by testing a wide family of shapes and multiple turning points.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Leveraging the CentileBrain pipeline, we opted for multivariable fractional polynomial regression implemented with the mfp package in R. This algorithm can determine the functional form of the predictor by testing a wide family of shapes and multiple turning points while providing a good fit at the extremes of the covariates.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Yang2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Normative modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional subcortical volume (n=14 regions), regional cortical thickness (n=68 regions), and regional surface area (n=68 regions) were modeled. Total intracranial volume was also extracted but used as a covariate, not as a response variable.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Estimation of individual morphometric measures included the total intracranial volume, regional subcortical volume (n=14), regional cortical thickness (n=68), and surface area (n=68).
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Yang2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Data preprocessing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as primary covariates. Additionally, intracranial volume was used for subcortical volume models, mean cortical thickness for cortical thickness regional models, and mean surface area for surface area regional models. Site was addressed through ComBat-GAM harmonization (treated as a random factor).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Using age and sex as covariates, normative models for each regional morphometric measure were developed... The optimal covariate combination included site harmonization (ComBat-GAM) (Pomponio et al. 2020) and the incorporation of intracranial volume, mean cortical thickness, and mean surface area in the regional models for subcortical volume, cortical thickness, and surface area regional measures, respectively.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Yang2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Normative modeling
